name: fantasy402-secured-api
title: Fantasy402 Secured API
description: Security-hardened OpenAPI contract generated from observed Fantasy402 traffic. The examples spec is the safe developer-portal reference for client teams.
securityInvariants: No real credential values in schemas, examples, static docs, or manifest artifacts
First-party operations declare browser-observed authentication context: session cookie, bearer token, Cloudflare clearance cookies, and browser metadata headers where applicable
First-party operations carry x-required-roles and x-rate-limit metadata
High-risk financial endpoints include synthetic examples and contract tests
Authentication request schemas mark password fields as writeOnly, x-sensitive, and security-review-required
Manager/getWebLog remains deprecated until replacement audit-log endpoint exists
Report/getTicketDetailPrint remains manual-review until valid backend method is observed
Authentication flow constants are non-sensitive and must not be stored as secrets unless policy requires blanket secret storage
publishNotes: Publish openapi.secured.examples.yaml to the developer portal. Use openapi.secured.slim.yaml for SDK generation and CI linting. The static docs can be published to Cloudflare Pages from the site directory.

workerRuntimeMatrix.valuePolicy: presence-only; values must remain in Cloudflare Secrets Store or Worker secrets

authFlowConstants.valuePolicy: non-sensitive; may be hardcoded or stored as plain Worker vars, not secrets

authRefresh.precedence: AUTH_CACHE overlay is applied before configured Fantasy402 auth secrets
authRefresh.valuePolicy: write-only; response returns accepted field names, expiresAt, and ttlSeconds only
